WITH picked AS (SELECT id FROM email_outbox WHERE state='pending' AND next_attempt_at<=$1 AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=$1) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT $2) UPDATE email_outbox o SET lease_id=$3,lease_until=$4,attempts=o.attempts+1 FROM picked WHERE o.id=picked.id RETURNING o.id,o.user_id,o.recipient,o.template,o.encrypted_params,o.attempts,o.lease_until
UPDATE email_outbox SET state='delivered',delivered_at=$3,encrypted_params=NULL,lease_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=$1 AND lease_id=$2 AND lease_until>$3 AND state='pending'
